name: Career Explorations (Mentorship and Internship)
what_you_do: Teens do a 4 Saturday job training and mentor program. Then they can apply for a paid summer internship with Seattle Parks. Interns work 20 hours a week for 8 weeks, for example on summer meals and playgrounds.
who_can_apply: Mentorship is for ages 13 to 21. The paid internship is for ages 15.5 to 21 and requires finishing the mentorship first. An E-13 form is required under 18.
pay_detail: Mentorship: $300 stipend if you attend all 4 Saturdays. Internship: Seattle minimum wage, listed as $21.30 per hour in 2026.
duration: Mentorship: 4 Saturdays (28 hours), offered 5 times a year. Internship: 8 summer weeks, 20 hours a week.
deadline_text: Page says mentorship applications opened in August 2026. Mentorship starts the first Saturday of October, November, February, March and April. No close date stated.
how_to_apply: Apply online for the mentor program. Links are on the page. Go to all four Saturdays. Then apply and interview for the summer internship. You must apply again each year.
notes: Free to join. Food and supplies are provided. Mentorship location rotates around Seattle (North, Central, Southeast, Southwest). Interns can return for up to 3 years. Work permit rule not stated on the page.
